summary: End-to-end verification of Weekly Win Report v2 (redemptions-first layout, POS reconciliation gate, prize payout breakdown, 8-channel activity roll-up) on backend + frontend. All 15 tests requested by main agent (test_report_v2.py + test_locations_weekly.py) pass. Added test_report_v2_extras.py (8 additional integration checks) — all pass. Frontend Weekly Win Report card renders with every required data-testid (21/21), correct order, correct copy/colors, no console errors. PDF one-pager downloads and text extraction confirms 'Proven at the Register', POS reconciliation red line, 'Prize Payouts', 'Channel Activity' with all 8 rows and the '(Actionable clicks & engagement unlock…)' note on the 5 stubbed social platforms and '(stub mode)' on Welcome Emails. Light regression on Command Center + Maximizer pages: both render clean, zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~3070 lines — recurring feedback: extract maximizer/, reports/, auth/, scheduler/ modules to keep files under 700 lines. Non-blocking, but debt keeps accruing.

WeeklyWinReport.js is clean (130 lines), typed data-testids match the review spec 1:1 (win-pos-import, win-stat-{redeemed,revenue,scans,spins,newMembers}, win-prize-breakdown, win-channels, win-channel-{wheel,google,facebook,instagram,tiktok,youtube,calendar,email}, win-top-spot, win-top-game, win-so-far, report-email-settings, win-report-pdf-btn).

PDF layout uses reportlab canvas.drawString with explicit y coords — fine for now, but if a store name is long or one more section is added, text can collide. Consider Platypus flowables for future-proofing.
log_activity() writes are best-effort (fire-and-forget after main response builds) — behaviour verified: publish-all still returns 200 and posImport.lastImportAt populates on next weekly-report call.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (21/21 required data-testids visible, PDF downloads, no console errors on Overview or Maximizer)

seed_data_creation: Two POS-import test rows created via CSV: report-v2@test.example (existing) + csvlog-iter19@test.example (new). Main agent noted these @test.example rows are safe to leave; they will be cleaned up later. One publish-all call was made against connected platforms.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Weekly Win Report v2 is 100% green. If you re-run: (a) pytest tests/test_report_v2.py tests/test_locations_weekly.py tests/test_report_v2_extras.py -q → 23 passed; (b) PDF text can be extracted with pdfminer.six (pip-installed in this env) and should contain the four new anchors; (c) POS red state is EXPECTED for the report week window — main agent confirmed the report window is the last completed Mon–Sun, so an import today does NOT flip importedThisWeek. Do NOT flag that as a bug. Emergent Google OAuth flow was not exercised in this iteration (out of scope for the review request); use session_token=tok_owner_e2e cookie for owner access.
rca of the issue: No product bugs found. One transient test-authoring issue was self-fixed: initial PDF text assertion fell back to a raw-bytes scan and missed the compressed-stream text; installing pdfminer.six made the extraction reliable and the assertions correctly matched the rendered PDF text.
